resources.title: Operational Maturity Self-Assessment
resources.description: A 50-point diagnostic assessment that evaluates your organisation's operational maturity across leadership, processes, people, technology, and metrics. Identify where you stand and get a prioritised roadmap for improvement.

resources.title: Manufacturing Cost Benchmark Tool
resources.description: Input your plant's key metrics — OEE, scrap rate, labour productivity, energy consumption — and instantly see how you compare to industry benchmarks. Built from data across 60+ Indian manufacturing facilities.

resources.title: Supply Chain Health Checklist
resources.description: A comprehensive checklist covering supplier management, inventory health, demand planning accuracy, logistics performance, and resilience readiness. Score your supply chain across 40 critical dimensions.

resources.title: Lean Readiness Scorecard
resources.description: A structured scorecard to assess your organisation's readiness for Lean transformation. Evaluates cultural factors, process maturity, management commitment, and infrastructure requirements before you invest in Lean.

resources.title: QMS Audit Preparation Checker
resources.description: An interactive checklist for ISO 9001, IATF 16949, or other QMS audits. Check off items across documentation, process control, audits, corrective action, supplier quality, and customer focus.

resources.title: ESG Compliance Roadmap
resources.description: Assess your readiness across Environment, Social, and Governance dimensions. Get a compliance timeline and action plan for BRSR reporting for Indian manufacturers.
